def min_operations_to_one_inversion(n, p):
    # Count the number of inversions in the permutation
    inversions = 0
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i + 1, n):
            if p[i] > p[j]:
                inversions += 1
    
    # If there is already one inversion, no operations are needed
    if inversions == 1:
        return 0

    if inversions == 0:

    return inversions - 1
